claims: Netflix is launching with the exclusive New York Yankees vs. San Francisco Giants Opening Night game on March 25, 2026.
The New York Yankees vs. San Francisco Giants Opening Night game kicks off a three-year partnership from 2026 to 2028.
The three-year partnership includes exclusive coverage of the T-Mobile Home Run Derby.
The three-year partnership includes exclusive coverage of the MLB Field of Dreams Game.
The 2026 T-Mobile Home Run Derby is on July 13 in Philadelphia.
The 2026 Field of Dreams Game is Phillies vs. Twins on August 13 in Iowa.
The games are exclusively on Netflix.
Netflix exclusivity often causes regional blackout restrictions.
The coverage is accessible with any standard Netflix subscription.
Adnan Virk is a former ESPN anchor expected to be involved in the coverage.
Netflix has featured the baseball documentary The Turnaround.
The Hill is a faith-based drama about a baseball player.
According to a Facebook post from Netflix UK and Ireland Fanpage, The Hill has been available on Netflix.
